question: How are these vidyas classified within the proclaimed set of ten great vidyas?
premises: These are identified as great vidyas.
A set of ten vidyas is proclaimed.
The named vidyas belong to that proclaimed set.
inference: These are proclaimed as belonging to the set of ten great vidyas.
uncertainties: Only some members of the ten are named in the immediately preceding verse.
plain_english: These indeed are proclaimed as the great vidyas, the ten vidyas.
